terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of TrustPro. This is a launch skeleton to be replaced by counsel-reviewed text before public launch.

sections.heading: 1. Using TrustPro
body: TrustPro connects clients with verified skilled workers in Cameroon. You must be able to form a binding contract to use the platform.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for activity under your account.

sections.heading: 2. Bookings and escrow
body: Payments for jobs are held in escrow and released according to the Refund & Dispute Policy. TrustPro is not a party to the contract between a client and a worker.

sections.heading: 3. Prohibited conduct
body: You may not use TrustPro to defraud, harass, or endanger others, or to circumvent the platform’s payment or verification systems.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How TrustPro collects, uses and protects your data. This is a launch skeleton to be replaced by counsel-reviewed text before public launch.

sections.heading: 1. What we collect
body: Account details, verification documents (ID, selfie, address), portfolio media, and activity on the platform such as jobs, quotes and messages.
Verification media is access-controlled and encrypted at rest.

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
body: To operate the marketplace, compute Trust Scores, process escrow payments, and keep the platform safe.

sections.heading: 3. Your rights
body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, subject to legal and operational retention requirements.

refunds.title: Refund & Dispute Policy
refunds.intro: How escrow, refunds and disputes work on TrustPro. This is a launch skeleton to be replaced by counsel-reviewed text before public launch.

sections.heading: 1. Escrow
body: Payment for a job is held by TrustPro when you accept a quote and released to the worker only when you confirm completion.

sections.heading: 2. Opening a dispute
body: If the work is not completed as agreed, open a dispute instead of confirming completion. The escrowed funds stay held while the dispute is reviewed.

sections.heading: 3. Refunds
body: Approved refunds are returned through the original payment channel. Resolution timelines depend on the payment provider.
